messages:
jamie_acme: Heads up — after upgrading our runtime to redwood-sdk 1.23.0 this morning we're seeing occasional duplicate POSTs to /v1/generate and a couple of customers reported double charges.

maya_support: sorry to hear that. can you share pip freeze + a tiny repro? how frequent and which endpoint(s)?

jamie_acme: ~1-4% of requests double-hit, /v1/generate. pip freeze + code below (python 3.9):

jamie_acme:
```
redwood-sdk==1.23.0
httpx==0.23.3
requests==2.31.0
```

jamie_acme:
```
import os
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
for _ in range(1000):
    resp = c.generate(model='redwood-rl', prompt='ping')
    # this runs in a threaded worker pool
```

jamie_acme: our app logs show a RetryError then a success within ~150-300ms. downstream logs show two distinct POSTs with same payload.

maya_support: can you paste the trimmed stack trace around the RetryError? also, were you setting client timeout or custom retry logic previously?

jamie_acme: trace (trimmed):
```
redwood.http.RetryError: connection reset by peer
  File "/app/.venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/redwood/http.py", line 212, in request
    raise RetryError('request failed')
# then server logs a successful request ~180ms later with same request body
```

jamie_acme: we weren't overriding timeouts; default client config.

maya_support: thanks. quick note: 1.23.0 introduced a change in the retry path that attempted to be more resilient on connection-level failures. unfortunately a race condition can re-issue POST bodies when a connection failure occurs during in-flight streaming fallback.

maya_support: immediate mitigation: pin to 1.22.3 while we roll a fix: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.22.3`. if you can't pin, add an Idempotency-Key header per request as a short-term guard: `headers={'Idempotency-Key': uuid}` — our gateway will dedupe identical keys for a small window.

alex_dev: from eng-runtime: acknowledged. PR #987 fixes dedupe token handling and disables the aggressive POST reissue path. we're preparing a 1.23.1 hotfix (backport) if tests pass. ETA ~48 hours for rollout to hosted.

jamie_acme: pinned to 1.22.3 in staging. duplicates dropped to ~0.2% (likely noise). thanks for the quick turnaround.

eng-oncall: FYI i added a telemetry gauge to prod to count repeated payloads per request_id for the next 24h to verify rollout doesn't regress.

deploy-bot: deploy requested: fix/987 -> staging at 2024-08-01T03:12:00Z

maya_support: closing loop for now. we'll publish 1.23.1 and follow up here. if you spot any lingering double-billing after the hotfix, please DM billing@redwood and we'll investigate credits on a case-by-case basis.

jamie_acme: will do, appreciate the help :thumbsup:
